benchmark.scope: only cases for which offline preflight did not plan a provider prompt

exact_gold_answer_match.population: rows with explicit gold_answer; exact normalized substring in non-abstained answer
exact_gold_answer_match.aggregation: micro exact text match, not semantic correctness

required_code_accuracy.population: temporal/comparison rows with old/new course codes; exact code in answer text

grounded_claim_precision.population: predicted answer claims across benchmark rows
grounded_claim_precision.aggregation: micro fraction of predicted claims supported by gold evidence

grounded_claim_recall.population: gold answer claims across benchmark rows
grounded_claim_recall.aggregation: micro fraction of gold claims recovered with support

unsupported_claim_leakage.population: predicted answer claims across benchmark rows
unsupported_claim_leakage.aggregation: micro fraction of predicted claims that are unsupported

contradicted_claim_leakage.population: predicted answer claims across benchmark rows
contradicted_claim_leakage.aggregation: micro fraction of predicted claims that are contradicted

citation_precision.aggregation: micro fraction of citations matching gold evidence

citation_recall.population: gold claim-evidence links across benchmark rows
citation_recall.aggregation: micro fraction of gold evidence links cited

citation_coordinate_validity.aggregation: micro fraction with valid document/page/chunk coordinates

answerable_false_abstention_rate.aggregation: micro fraction of answerable rows incorrectly abstained

unanswerable_false_positive_rate.aggregation: micro fraction answered instead of abstained

schema_validity.aggregation: micro fraction passing internal and public response schemas

abstention_precision.aggregation: micro fraction of predicted abstentions that are unanswerable

abstention_reason_accuracy.population: benchmark rows with an owner-labeled gold_abstention_reason
abstention_reason_accuracy.aggregation: micro exact match after canonicalizing the abstention reason taxonomy

semantic_answer_correctness.reason: exact answer-text match does not establish semantic correctness; human labels are required
semantic_answer_correctness.aggregation: human-labeled semantic correctness; no gold labels are currently bound

peak_working_set_bytes.reason: the scorer process is not the product execution process; bind a product execution manifest
peak_working_set_bytes.population: product process during the bound benchmark run
peak_working_set_bytes.aggregation: maximum resident working set in bytes

index_size_bytes.population: all files under the index directory bound by index_tree_sha256

latency.reason: preflight measurements mix prompted and no-prompt rows and are not a product acceptance run

limitations: This local-only subset excludes all 142 provider-prompt cases.
Three answerable rows in this subset all abstained; denominator is only 3.
No semantic correctness labels, provider-backed outputs, or working-set execution manifest are included.
Historical exposure remains; this is regression-only and cannot pass Phase 8.
